reason: I've never heard of FLUGIA and I'm not letting an unknown AI talk to my customers or dig through my Google account on the strength of a 'GDPR-compliant' line. At most I'd poke at the free plan with nothing sensitive connected, but I wouldn't pay for it this month.
objection: Who are these people, where is my data actually stored, and what happens when the AI says something wrong to a customer in my name? If they disappear in two years, I've built my processes on something that's gone.
would_change_my_mind: A small business owner like me, in Belgium or France, telling me it's worked for them for a year, plus a setting where nothing goes out to a customer without me approving it first, the same way I sign off invoices on Fridays.
